name: io.github.beautifulboy9527/movaui-catalog
title: MovaUI Cloud Catalog MCP
description: Browse AI motion website prompts, 60FPS looping backgrounds, and frontend Agent Skills.

tools.name: mova_catalog_search
tools.description: Search MovaUI's motion website prompts and 60FPS loop video backgrounds by keyword, asset kind, price tier, animation technique, or anonymous public showcase flag. Read-only and zero quota cost; returns item IDs, categories, safe excerpts, and preview URLs.

query.description: Keyword matching title, category, description, or tags

kind.description: Catalog asset type to search: prompts, backgrounds, or all

price.description: Filter results by free or paid access tier

technique.description: Optional motion technique ID (e.g. framer-motion, gsap, threejs, webgl, lenis, css-motion)

showcase_only.description: When true, return only zero-login flagship public showcase prompts

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-30, default 10)

offset.description: Pagination offset into the matched result set (default 0)

tools.name: mova_catalog_list_techniques
tools.description: List supported web motion techniques (Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js, WebGL, Lenis, CSS Motion), top categories, and live prompt/background counts. Read-only, anonymous, and zero quota cost.

tools.name: mova_catalog_get_prompt
tools.description: Fetch the full structured motion website prompt blueprint for one item ID returned by mova_catalog_search. Flagship public showcase prompts work anonymously; other free and PRO prompts require a read-only Personal Access Token (Authorization: Bearer mova_pat_...) and share the user's web quota and non-expiring Boost Credits.

id.description: Prompt ID or slug returned by mova_catalog_search

tools.name: mova_catalog_get_background
tools.description: Fetch temporary signed 1080P 60FPS stream/download URLs and a responsive HTML/React embed snippet for one animated background ID or slug. Requires a Personal Access Token (mova_pat_...); paid backgrounds require VIP/SVIP/Lifetime membership and consume zero prompt quota.

id.description: Background ID or slug returned by mova_catalog_search

tools.name: mova_skill_list
tools.description: List all 21 cloud-hosted MovaUI website design, motion choreography, SEO/GEO, and QA skills with required tier, focus_topics, and live unlock status. Read-only and zero quota cost.

category.description: Filter cloud skills by functional category

tier.description: Filter cloud skills by required tier (free=Starter, member=VIP, pro=SVIP)

tools.name: mova_skill_invoke
tools.description: Fetch a concise, stack-adaptive execution blueprint for any of MovaUI's 21 cloud skills (design, motion, layout, shaders, copy, SEO/GEO, pricing, typography, WCAG 2.2, release). Starter skills (stack-adapter-skill, s3c-post-baseline-editor, ascii-animation-skill) work anonymously with rate limits; VIP and SVIP skills unlock via Bearer PAT. Call mova_skill_list first to inspect available focus_topics per skill_id.

skill_id.description: Exact skill ID from MovaUI Cloud (all 21 skills supported)

focus.description: Focused sub-topic from the skill's focus_topics list (default: overview)

task_context.description: Brief summary of the page, component, or engineering issue you are solving

stack.description: Target frontend stack (e.g. Next.js 15 + Tailwind v4, Vite + React 19, Vue 3, Astro)

tools.name: mova_design_calibrate
tools.description: VIP+ server-side design calibration powered by MovaUI's 1,151-site empirical baseline and W3C DTCG / OKLCH dark-mode parity engine. Returns typography scales, fold budgets, glare-free dark tokens, motion budgets, and anti-slop guardrails without exposing raw corpus files.

project_type.description: Visual archetype for typography and spacing calibration

brand_hex.description: Optional primary brand color in hex (e.g. #6D28D9) to derive glare-free dark-mode guidance

dark_mode.description: Whether to include OKLCH dark-mode parity elevation & token rules

audience.description: Optional target user persona or product summary

tools.name: mova_gate_audit
tools.description: SVIP / Lifetime server-side deterministic quality gate. Evaluates lightweight JSON payloads for copy_purity (anti-AI-slop & unverified claims), seo_cannibalization (route title/description overlap & dead schema), pricing_integrity (annual discount math & placeholders), or css_a11y (WCAG 2.2 / Tailwind v4 / compositing checks) and returns Pass/Fail verdicts with fixes.

audit_type.description: Which server-side deterministic quality gate to run

payload.description: Input JSON for the selected gate: copy_purity -> {text: string}; seo_cannibalization -> {routes: [{route, locale?, title, description}], schemas?: string[]}; pricing_integrity -> {currency: string, tiers: [{id, monthly?, yearly?, claimed_discount_pct?, price_source?, checkout_ref?}]}; css_a11y -> {code: string}

tools.name: mova_skill_feedback
tools.description: Zero-quota closed-loop feedback tool. Submit sanitized friction reports when a MovaUI skill, motion spec, or MCP setup step hits a framework edge case, build warning, or missing capability. Automatically scrubs local paths and secrets.

skill_id.description: Related skill ID (e.g. stack-adapter-skill, motion-choreography-skill) or general-mcp

issue_type.description: Category of friction or improvement suggestion

severity.description: Severity of the friction encountered: low, medium, or high

agent_client.description: Editor/agent name (e.g. claude-code, cursor, windsurf, vscode, codex, antigravity)

stack_fingerprint.description: Detected user project stack (e.g. vite-react18-tw3, nextjs16-app-tw4, astro5)

symptom.description: Concise sanitized description of what went wrong or what skill/rule was missing (never include secrets)

root_cause.description: Technical root cause discovered on the local project

workaround_applied.description: How you fixed or adapted it locally so other users benefit

suggested_rule.description: Concrete rule or new skill capability MovaUI should add

resolved_locally.description: Whether you successfully resolved the issue on the user's project
